text: OfflineMessageReadListener first forwards stop to its destination. It discards the offline copy only when the incoming stream status failed and mail.discard_offline_msg_on_failure is true, then clears its channel reference and returns the destination result. A destination error alone is not that discard condition. Discard permits a later download; it is not an immediate retry or proof the next read will succeed. No stream or recovery test ran.
title: Offline read invalidation follows incoming stream status and its preference
